description: Return evidence-native benchmark records for ExergyNet xLMP experiments. Every record carries benchmark_id, measured_value, unit, tested_envelope, derivation_type (MEASURED | DERIVED | REFERENCE_ONLY), evidence_class, evidence_sha256, publicly_verifiable, and universal_claim=false. publicly_verifiable=true would mean a public consumer can independently obtain and verify the referenced evidence artifact from the record alone, without internal access; it is false here because no public artifact URL exists yet (the evidence documents are internal/sealed), so verification currently requires possession of the named artifact and recomputation of its SHA-256. Use vmn_context_cost_compare to derive economic implications from this data.

benchmark_id.description: Filter to a specific benchmark_id. Omit to return all records. Known IDs: LNES82C10M-HOLDOUT-MEAN-K, LNES82C10M-STATE-RATIO, LNES82C10M-ACCURACY, LNES82C4M-OLS-9PT-SLOPE, H200-XLMP-CORRECT-TASK-THROUGHPUT

include_derivations.description: If true, include derivation_notes fields. Default: false.

name: vmn_benchmark_evidence
